name: rust-build-host
description: A CPU build host for Rust on a Hetzner Cloud server: the apt packages a cargo build usually wants (build-essential, pkg-config, libssl-dev, git, rsync, curl) and a rustup toolchain pinned to an exact version with clippy and rustfmt, so `cargo build` / `cargo clippy` / `cargo fmt --check` run on the machine after `apply`. The toolchain is pinned to a release rather than `stable`, because `stable` moves under the same profile hash; bump the pin deliberately. Declares no requires_ports and no requires_disk: the platform maps no port, and the disk comes with the server type, so a size is refused at admission. The provider slot carries only the image; add the account-specific keys yourself — `hetzner.server_type` (e.g. cpx62), `hetzner.location`, `hetzner.ssh_keys` (names of keys already in the project; required, a server without one is refused) and, optionally, `hetzner.firewalls` (ids). The session is root over ssh, so the default remote dir applies.

phases.script:
set -e
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- --profile minimal --default-toolchain 1.97.1 -y
. "$HOME/.cargo/env"
rustup component add clippy rustfmt
rustc --version
cargo --version
